excerpt: Sign in to the tiyuvta inference console.
content_html:
account

Sign in or create an account.

One step. The same screen creates the account, so there is nothing to confirm afterwards and no waiting list.

free credit$10.00 of credit is added to your account on sign-up. 87 of 100 places left.

Base URL
https://api.tiyuvta.ai/v1

Models
qwen/qwen3.8-27b · Step-3.7-Flash in bring-up

Price
$0.40 input · $0.10 cached · $2.90 output per million tokens

Billing
Prepaid credit. At zero balance the API returns 402.
